scope: A new internal Docker network, PostgreSQL 18.6 empty database, API, web proxy, worker, and browse-maintenance startup proof. No provider, source, operator, or production target is accepted.
guards: Refuses remote Docker endpoints through the shared local-target guard.
Requires API and web image revision labels to equal the supplied full revision.
Passes private values only from the controller process environment to Docker --env keys; no secret-bearing env file or command-line secret is created.

Applies migrations to a newly created database, disables all source and epoch enabled flags, then proves that pre-worker condition and empty jobs, logical calls, observations, evidence, and projects. The worker may synchronize registry state later, so the receipt does not claim source flags remain disabled after startup.
Uses the explicit disabled provider and budget runtime environment, an internal network, and no host-published service ports.

Starts the API on the internal api alias, then worker, browse maintenance, and web; requires worker heartbeat and published empty browse before authenticated workspace reads and web proxy proof in a 15 second bounded probe.
After services stop, requires zero jobs, logical calls, logical-call budgets, observations, evidence, and projects.
On success removes only captured container IDs and the exact captured network ID; any failure preserves owned resources and writes a sanitized receipt.

commands: backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q backend/tests/unit/test_release_rehearsal.py with synthetic process-local required settings
validation.result: syntax, lint, and CLI help passed; release-helper focused tests passed 8/8; Docker runtime intentionally not run

acceptance: A successful controller run reports PASS_SERVICE_STARTUP only. It is not commercial, provider, release, production-Go, or Finish Contract acceptance.
